internal-code.role: Generator data/config (perchance-js): the print button + print CSS, exposed as $output
Generator body HTML: documentation page for the plugin, uses [$output]

build-config.role: No build pipeline. The generator is authored directly in the Perchance editor; the platform bundles main.pjs + index.html at runtime. No package.json, bundler, lockfile, or transpiler is used.

externalRuntimeDependencies.name: perchance-engine
externalRuntimeDependencies.note: Platform-provided engine that renders main.pjs + index.html. Not authored or bundled by this project.

externalRuntimeDependencies.name: cloudflare-insights-beacon
externalRuntimeDependencies.note: Injected by the Perchance hosting platform; not a project asset.

notes: This generator declares NO {import:...} statements at runtime. The string '{import:print-button-plugin}' appears in index.html only as escaped documentation text inside a <pre> block, so there is no imports/ tree to ship.
No images, audio, models, shaders, animations, JSON data, prefabs, or fonts are referenced or generated by this project.
The entire shipped generator = main.pjs + index.html.
